ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism is at the top of the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web with labeled organisms: Spartina at the lower left, Prokelisia near the bottom center, Pardosa on the left middle, Grammonota in the center, Tytthus on the right, and Hogna near the top. Several arrows point upward or inward toward Hogna, and there is no arrow shown leading from Hogna to another higher organism. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows show energy transfer from food/prey toward the consumer. The organism at the top of the food chain is the one that receives arrows from others and is not shown being eaten by another organism. Since Hogna is at the top and has arrows pointing to it without arrows leading away to a higher predator, the top organism is Hogna.
